items.description: Touristica is a Turkish tourism agency been serving the travel services industry since 1994. Providing quality service to customers is of utmost importance, and Touristica wants to create importance and value in tourism opportunities for guests and partners.

The Road Kill Map mashup is a visual representation of the 1.24 million death that occur every year on roadways across the world. Aggressively styled on Google Maps, this mashup is a visual masterpiece.

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.
